cases.goal: Fix ceil_div(a, b) so it returns the mathematical ceiling of integer division for positive and negative integer operands. Division by zero must raise ZeroDivisionError.

files.solution.py:
def ceil_div(a, b):
    return a // b

cases.goal: Fix parse_row(line) to parse exactly one CSV record using standard comma delimiters and double-quote escaping. Preserve whitespace inside unquoted fields and trailing empty fields.

Repair Ledger.transfer and apply_transfer across both Python files. Transfers require distinct known accounts and a strictly positive int amount (bool is invalid), sufficient funds, and atomic balances on any rejection. Unknown accounts raise KeyError; other invalid transfers raise ValueError. Remember a request ID only after success. A repeated successful request returns False with no changes; a rejected request ID can be retried after its cause is repaired.
